question: What claim about the totality of yoginīs is at stake in referring to the whole field-group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: Together they form a single all-field group.
inference: The totality of earth-moving and sky-moving yoginīs is presented as a complete field-group.
uncertainties: The internal structure of that field-group is not specified here.
plain_english: The whole field-group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
